title: `receiveMessage()` will revert when it runs out of gas
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Protocol uses CCIP messaging in a strict way. It means that further messages per lane can't be processed until the execution of previous messages succeeds. As soon as any action can revert in `LaPoste.receiveMessage()`, further messages can't be processed.  How an attacker can make his message revert. It uses `try catch` to execute a call to the attacker's contract:  ```solidity         /// 2. Execute the message.         bool success;         if (message.payload.length > 0) { @>          try IMessageReceiver(message.to).
